title: Phase 0 / E00: Literature/Claim Freeze, Novelty Contract & Code Synchronization Protocol
primary_question: What is the exact scope of novelty for Governed Read-to-Write Continuity (GRWC) relative to prior art in OCC, PBAC, PCFS, LPM, and MemTX, and are all baseline code repositories synchronized to frozen commit SHAs without dirty working trees?
unit_of_analysis: One complete literature claim audit and code synchronization verification pass across the 15-experiment campaign.

primary_endpoints.name: Claim-to-Code Alignment Index
primary_endpoints.definition: 1.0 if 100% of claimed invariants map to active codebase code anchors without forbidden claims, 0.0 otherwise.

secondary_endpoints.name: Forbidden Claim Regex Compliance Rate
secondary_endpoints.definition: 1.0 if zero forbidden overclaim terms exist in manuscript sources, 0.0 otherwise.

sample_size.unit_definition: 47 tracked paper claims and code anchor cross-validations

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: Any unbacked or violating claim halts release gating.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Missing anchors are recorded as UNALIGNED.
